name: Espressif ESP32-C3 (RISC-V single core)

flash_psram_gpio.notes: GPIO12-17 are the SPI flash bus (in-package flash on C3FN4/FH4 uses them internally). GPIO11 is VDD_SPI by default (usable as GPIO only after an eFuse change).

adc2_wifi_conflict.note: GPIO5 is ADC2_CH0; Espressif/Seeed say ADC2 is unreliable, use ADC1 (GPIO0-4) for analog.
adc2_wifi_conflict.approx_note: From Seeed wiki + ESP-IDF docs, not datasheet text.

caution_gpio.8: strapping: boot mode/ROM log (must be high for download)

notes: GPIO0/1 are the 32 kHz crystal pins if one is fitted; GPIO4-7 are JTAG (fine as GPIO).

chip_level.G{n}: GPIOn on many clones (but a bare 'G' is GND)
chip_level.{n}: bare number next to a header = GPIOn on Espressif DevKits
chip_level.BOOT: button on the boot strapping GPIO

board_level.D{n}: Arduino/XIAO-style digital number. NOT GPIOn on XIAO or Arduino Nano ESP32; look up the board's own map
board_level.SDA / SCL: board/framework default I2C, board-specific (ESP32 can route I2C to almost any GPIO)

never_map: D0..D3 printed next to CLK/CMD on classic ESP32 DevKitC = flash pins, NOT Arduino D0-D3

provenance.notes: Strapping GPIO2/8/9 and USB GPIO18/19 quoted from the datasheet. GPIO11 VDD_SPI and flash 12-17: datasheet pin table (approx for your exact package).
